purpose: Define the priority hierarchy for determining current Factory state during mount/bootstrap. Prevents stale Attach Packets from directing work based on outdated phase information.

level_1_highest.description: Verifier-passed machine-readable results — the canonical truth for completed phases
level_1_highest.rule: If verifier JSON says phase is PASS/COMPLETED, no lower-level source can override this

level_2.description: Phase ledger — the structured record of completed phases
level_2.rule: Phase ledger latest completed entry determines lastCompletedPhase

level_3.rule: currentTrustedPhase must be consistent with verifier results; if mismatch, verifier wins

level_4.rule: Active thread records what is currently being worked on; must be consistent with phase ledger

level_5.rule: Direction guard recommends next phase but does not override verifier on what is already complete

level_6.rule: Attach Packet is DERIVED from higher-priority sources; it is NOT itself a source of truth. Stale packet must be regenerated.

level_7_lowest.description: Compressed summaries, legacy notes, stale rotation packets
level_7_lowest.rule: NEVER used as source of truth for current phase. Archived warnings only.

override_rules.rule: A phase marked PASS by verifier (level 1) cannot be shown as pending or in-progress by any lower-level source
override_rules.action: REJECT lower-level claim; use verifier status

override_rules.rule: Legacy rotation risks (level 7) cannot override current next-phase recommendation unless confirmed as active blocker (activeRisk=true AND blocker=true)
override_rules.action: Archive legacy warnings; surface only confirmed active blockers

override_rules.rule: Attach Packet must include freshnessStatus and sourceOfTruthPaths so consumer can audit staleness
If current_phase in Attach Packet matches lastCompletedPhase from phase-ledger, flag as STALE — phase is complete, not current
override_rules.action: WARN; currentPhase should be current working activity, not last completed phase

state_field_mapping.activeBlockers: risk-ledger.jsonl entries where activeRisk=true AND blocker=true
